doc: FBL 0.12, section 8.6 (an entry that follows its key), FR-029, edge case 19: etalii.adp.ide.standalone/src/diagrams/wardley-map/examples/example 2/annotations-and-labels.owm at ad1a4680a with its .adp and .identities.json, unchanged. Renaming Kettle to Electric Kettle replaces its name and rewrites the two links that name it (section 5.7), and in the same edit moves the three identity entries whose keys are computed from those values, the component's and the two links', each by a replace-value of its key, written with RFC 8785's escapes; the ids stay. The undo moves the keys back, byte for byte as the tool wrote them. A rename of Kettle to Power, the name another component holds, is refused and writes nothing.

steps.doc: The rename: the name and the two references in the body, and the three keys in the identities file, in one edit.

annotations [0.60, 0.02]

note Tea is the point of all this [0.22, 0.30]

steps.doc: The undo puts the name, the references and the keys back.
